messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Westmere,

Further to discussions between our respective principals, please find attached the mutual non-disclosure agreement in connection with the proposed transaction. Subject to your review we'd be grateful if you could arrange signature so that we can begin sharing information.

Kind regards,
James Osei
